absorption: Upstream provides equivalent BGE-M3 model token limits, lossless source-span chunking, offline pinned artifact validation and dispatch contracts.

consumers.name: Self-hosted Honcho API, message ingestion, embedding reconciliation and deriver.

contract: BGE-M3 embedding inputs are counted with the pinned official offline tokenizer including special tokens, capped at the lowest of 8192, MAX_INPUT_TOKENS and MAX_TOKENS_PER_REQUEST, without downloads or truncation.

Long embedding inputs become exact original Unicode spans with 20 percent token overlap, full source coverage, per-span revalidation, stable sibling order and actual token-aware batching; overlength single queries and unchunked documents fail before provider dispatch.
The lexical deduplication encoding and non-BGE embedding tokenizer behavior remain unchanged.

fork: Set TEST_BGE_M3_TOKENIZER_PATH to the pinned local artifact and HONCHO_CONFIG_TOML_DISABLED=1; run uv run --frozen python -m pytest -n 0 tests/llm/test_bge_embedding_tokenizer.py tests/llm/test_embedding_client.py.
proof.fork_expected: Real tokenizer boundary 8192 accepts and 8193 rejects before dispatch; exact Unicode spans cover all source, fit lower limits, preserve reconciliation order and charge actual batch counts. With input cap 16 and request cap 8, a 10-token query or unchunked document rejects before dispatch and generated persisted chunks and actual batches fit 8 tokens.
upstream: Inspect _EmbeddingClient initialization, query validation and _prepare_chunks on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: Unknown BGE model names use cl100k_base; no pinned BGE tokenizer, special-token-inclusive model cap or source-span validation exists.

replay: Keep the BGE tokenizer independent of embedding_client.encoding, used by lexical deduplication. Provision and read-only mount the documented pinned tokenizer.json at embedding.TOKENIZER_PATH for API and deriver; never fetch model assets during runtime. Rebuild image using pyproject.toml and uv.lock together.
upstream_gap: The recorded upstream embedding client falls back to cl100k_base for BGE-M3, accepts overlength model inputs, and chunks decoded token slices instead of retaining original source spans.
